_readme: One Industry Report per in-game month (index = month - 1). Each shows a real stat from stats.json as news; 'event' optionally runs a decision event that the stat makes more attractive. {value} is replaced with the formatted stat.

reports.headline: US BIKE SALES DIP
reports.body: US bike shops sold {value} in bikes, parts and service, down from $7.8B the year before. Riders are watching their wallets.

reports.headline: SERVICE PAYS
reports.body: Top-earning bike shops make {value} from repair parts and labor. Average shops make 6.5%.

reports.headline: E-BIKES SURGE
reports.body: E-bikes were {value} of US bike dollar sales, and 63% of all bike sales growth since 2019.

reports.headline: TRAILS ARE BUSY
reports.body: About {value} Americans ride mountain bikes. 41.5% of them ride 13 or more times a year.

reports.headline: CRASH REPORT
reports.body: ERs treated about {value} MTB fractures from 2013 to 2022. Fractures jumped 247% from 2019 to 2020.

reports.headline: MECHANIC PAY
reports.body: US bike mechanics earn about {value} on average (13,980 jobs).

reports.headline: TRAIL TOURISTS
reports.body: Mountain bike visitors spend about {value} on average. Towns with trails are cashing in.

reports.headline: PARTS MARGINS
reports.body: Bike shops keep about a {value} margin on parts and accessories, better than the 36% on bikes.

reports.headline: E-BIKES KEEP GROWING
reports.body: E-bike unit sales rose {value} in early 2024. Average shop e-bike price: $3,055.

reports.headline: WHAT WINNERS EARN
reports.body: High-profit bike stores net about {value} a year. The average store nets $46,000.

reports.headline: KIDS RIDE TOO
reports.body: Kids' bikes were {value} of all bikes sold in the US. Today's groms are tomorrow's customers.

reports.headline: MORE E-RIDERS
reports.body: {value} of US bike riders used an e-bike, up from 7.8% two years earlier.
